system_title: Ashen Oath - Liechtenauer Grandmaster Combat Architecture
engine_target: Unreal Engine 5.8 C++ / Gameplay Ability System (GAS)

core_philosophical_pillars.description: Blades in contact measure physical resistance (Weak/Weich vs Strong/Hart), determining whether to plunge directly (Vor) or mutate around the bind (Nach).
Attacking first with an authentic Master Cut seizes the Vor, forcing the defender into the Nach and preventing counter-hits.
Every Master Cut closes a line of attack with the crossguard or false edge while simultaneously threatening a lethal opening.

tactical_interaction_rules.rationale: Diagonal cleave intersects high descending cuts, taking the center line and threatening an immediate Zorn-Ort thrust.
Crossed-wrist offline step strikes the exposed hands and wrists over the high crossguard.
High horizontal short-edge helicopter cut creates an impenetrable roof above Kaelen's head while striking the opponent's temple.
Plunging false-edge cut beats down the opponent's forward-pointing blade, driving the point directly into the neck/collarbone.
Maximum extension down the vertical centerline crushes the low-resting point before the opponent can lift it to guard.
Inverted pommel strike delivers 100% armor-penetrating blunt impact, inducing high concussion and poise failure.
